findings.source_quote: “how far do we practice it?”; “practicing friendship, practicing fellowship”; “time for the practice of fellowship with God”; “back to the practice of our fellowship”
findings.suggested_fix: Use a more idiomatic expression for practicing or living out the fellowship, such as “kuishi katika ushirika” or “kudumisha ushirika,” consistently in these passages.
findings.translation_quote: “tunautendea kazi kwa kiwango gani?”; “kutendea urafiki kazi, kutendea ushirika kazi”; “kutendea ushirika na Mungu kazi”; “kwenye kutendea ushirika wetu kazi”
